Policy.description:
Founded in Cairo, Egypt, in February 2020, Exclusive Movies Ltd launched its flagship product — Ex Pro Media Player — to empower users across the MENA region with a secure, privacy-first media player designed exclusively for personal digital content.

Fueled by strong regional demand and a vision for international scalability, the company expanded its legal and operational footprint to the United Kingdom in 2021, establishing a dual-jurisdiction presence that bridges local innovation with global compliance standards.

Today, Exclusive Movies Ltd operates under the rigorous frameworks of both UK corporate law and Egyptian digital regulations, serving users and partners with integrity, transparency, and technical excellence.

OurMission.title: Our Mission
OurMission.description: To empower users and content providers with innovative, privacy-focused, cross-platform media solutions — prioritizing security, performance, and seamless usability across all devices and ecosystems.

ComplianceLegality.title: Compliance & Legality
ComplianceLegality.description: Exclusive Movies Ltd operates in full compliance with:

items: Premium subscription-based media applications (e.g., Ex Pro)
Per-device subscription model — each device requires an individual subscription; multi-device support refers to compatibility across platforms, not shared access
Multi-platform playback engines with adaptive bitrate streaming
Custom OTT & digital platform development for B2B clients
Egyptian Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020
Secure-by-default systems featuring end-to-end encryption, robust authentication, and regular third-party security audits
Legally binding Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) with all subprocessors — including Stripe and Paymob — ensuring full accountability under applicable data protection regimes

mediaPlayer.text: Ex Pro is a media-player application only. It does not host, store, transmit, distribute, or provide any built-in media content — licensed or otherwise.

mediaSources.text: All media sources, URLs, or streams added by the user are entirely user-provided and user-managed. Responsibility for the legality, ownership, or copyright status of such content rests solely with the end user.

dataProcessing.text: All data processing, payment handling, and refund procedures strictly adhere to our Public Privacy Policy and relevant consumer protection laws in the user’s jurisdiction.

UXEnhancement.title: UX Enhancement
UXEnhancement.subtitle: Pre-Purchase Notice (Recommended for App Stores & Website)
UXEnhancement.notice: Ex Pro subscriptions are digital services activated instantly upon payment. Refunds are not available except where mandated by local law or in cases of verified technical failure that prevents access to the service. For purchases made through Google Play or the Apple App Store, refund requests must be submitted directly through the respective platform.
UXEnhancement.footer: This notice enhances user transparency, minimizes support disputes, and aligns with the commercial policies of Google, Apple, Stripe, and global e-commerce best practices.
